entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please say 'Sales' or 'Support' to be connected.
Connecting you to a VeloFit support agent now.
Thank you for holding. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Hi Sarah. I need to start a return for some cycling shoes I purchased a while back.
I can certainly look into that for you. Do you have your order number handy?
Thank you. One moment... Okay, I see the order from October 14th for the Velo-Pro cycling shoes. Can I ask what the issue is with them?

I've tried to break them in, but they just don't fit my feet right. I keep getting terrible blisters on my heels after every class. I've even tried adjusting the cleats multiple times, but the fit is the core problem.
I'm very sorry to hear that they're causing you blisters; that's definitely not the experience we want for our customers. Let me just check the return eligibility for you.
Okay, I see here that your order was delivered 67 days ago. Our policy allows for returns within 90 days, so you are well within the window. I can go ahead and process a full refund for you.

That's great news, thank you. Since I did have to deal with the discomfort and the hassle of returning them, would it be possible to get a small discount code for a future purchase? I'd like to try a different model.

I understand your position. While I am able to process the full refund for the shoes, my system doesn't allow for issuing a promotional code on an order that's being returned. The good news is you'll get the full purchase price back once we receive the item.
I see. Well, a full refund is the main thing. I just figured it was worth asking. I'll get them sent back this week.

Excellent. I've just initiated the return in our system. You'll receive an email with a prepaid shipping label and instructions within the next 5-10 minutes. Just pack the shoes in their original box and drop it off. Once our warehouse scans it, the refund will be processed.
Sounds simple enough. Thank you for your help, Sarah.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
